decisions.reason: The 518 FLEX is an evolution of the established BASIC 518 trommel screen. It was publicly renamed and promoted for its further development, so it is tied to the firm's core screening line and the firm has a strong commitment to keep it.

The AK flail shredder series is a core mobile product line. Its whole model range was updated to EU Stage V engines and presented at a trade fair, a substantial and public investment that management will defend.

The mobile grinder gained a page of its own in 2019, which shows growing visibility. It is part of the firm's announced mobile shredding direction, so weak results would likely be read as temporary, even though a sister grinder variant was already withdrawn.

The CERON generation was publicly framed as setting standards in stationary single-shaft pre-shredders and is cited in reference installations. This high visibility and the investment behind it make dropping it unlikely.
